query:
UPDATE outbox o
              SET dead_at      = now(),
                  dead_reason  = $4,
                  last_error   = f.err,
                  locked_by    = NULL,
                  locked_until = NULL,
                  updated_at   = now()
             FROM UNNEST($1::uuid[], $2::text[]) AS f(id, err)
            WHERE o.id = f.id AND o.locked_by = $3
